protocol.dispatch: an episode of at least `persistence` consecutive ten-minute alarmed samples; a gap of more than max_gap_minutes ends an episode
protocol.false_dispatch: a dispatch on a healthy turbine-window, counted over the whole window
protocol.placebo: a 0 K ramp through the same code: a dispatch after the onset is a false dispatch that happened to land there, so it is the chance level a real detection has to be read against
protocol.threshold: each arm's own out-of-fold training residuals at the stated quantile, one-sided
